referents.why: 'he said' follows 'answered Job out of the whirlwind'; the one who answers and speaks is the LORD (masc sing). Job is the one addressed, not the speaker.
referents.category: implied subject of a speaking clause

links.why: wayyiqtol continues the narrative line: answered, and then said.
'said' introduces the LORD's speech, which begins in 38:2; the content link points forward to its first clause (R1).

groups.why: The LORD's speech to Job is opened by this saying clause; the outer turn holds the frame, the sender (the LORD) and the addressee (Job). Its part is the speech from 38:2 on, not yet judged.
groups.category: speech turn opened by a narrative saying

cant_tell.what: Whether the speech's parts from 38:2 to 38:38 form one turn or several nested turns
cant_tell.why: Only 38:1 is judged here; the parts are linked when those verses are judged.
